title: Silas and the Weather
author: Juniper Ravensworth
blurb: Isandro Oyelaran, a night librarian in a city that sleeps less every year, moves through the days like a tenant, not an owner. Then a childhood home goes up for auction — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must say goodbye properly, at last, out loud, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
